_note: LeJEPA SSL stage only. All sections are merged into one flat settings object. Origin of every value: README.md, section 'SSL recipe'.

setup._export_note: also export the backbone every 5 epochs, for the accuracy-versus-epoch analysis only; the backbone used for A2 is the final epoch, fixed in advance

optim._batch_note: 64 = same images per step as A1 DINO (Nischal, 2026-10-18), run on a 40 GB GPU (Pitt CRC A100). The PC pilot used 28 because of its 12 GB GPU.
optim._epochs_note: same number of epochs as A1 (Nischal's decision, 2026-10-16). NOT equal compute: one LeJEPA epoch takes about 1.8 times a DINO epoch here (about 14 h vs 7.6 h). A time-matched run (55 epochs) is a separate, later experiment
